title: Data Ingest
dailyIngest_tooltip: Raw uncompressed data ingested per day. This is the primary driver of cluster sizing. Include all data sources before any Elasticsearch compression.
compression_tooltip: LZ4: fast, ~1.1x compression ratio — best for hot tier. DEFLATE: ~0.85x ratio — good for warm tier. Best Compression: ~0.7x ratio — ideal for cold/frozen with low write throughput.
replicas_tooltip: Number of replica shards per primary. 1 replica doubles storage and shard count but provides high availability. 0 = no redundancy.
indexCount_tooltip: Total number of Elasticsearch indices. Affects shard count and JVM heap requirements. Each index has at least 1 primary shard × (1 + replicas).
